title: Transporting produce
rule: Anyone hauling or transporting logs, timber, withies, poles or charcoal must make sure it is lawfully obtained. Except charcoal for domestic use, they must use the roads and checkpoints on the transit pass.
points: A habitual offender's mechanically propelled vehicle is confiscated to the Government.
penalty: Produce obtained legally: fine of TSh 500,000 to 1,000,000, or imprisonment of not less than 3 months. Produce obtained illegally: fine of TSh 1,000,000 or three times the market value if greater, or 2 to 7 years in prison, plus confiscation.
flag: Reg 16(3)(a) states no maximum prison term.
